english.title: Move animal that may carry disease on to or off premises in pig surveillance zone
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) moved an animal other than a pig, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), which may have carried disease,

(A)_[on to]_
(B)_[off]_

premises on which pigs were kept, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), in a surveillance zone declared following confirmation of disease in domestic pigs,

(C)_[other than under a licence granted by a veterinary inspector]_
(D)_[when not all persons entering or leaving such premises where pigs were kept observed appropriate biosecurity measures to reduce the risk of spread of disease]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 15(a) of Schedule 3 to and regulation 39(1)(s) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
moved an animal other than a pig which may have carried disease
on to or off premises on which pigs were kept
in a surveillance zone declared following confirmation of disease in domestic pigs
other than under a licence granted by a veterinary inspector or
when not all persons entering or leaving such premises where pigs were kept
observed appropriate biosecurity measures to reduce the risk of spread of disease

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
